description: Tokenized Asset Purchase: submit a token’s claimed backing with its records: the claim with the backing claimed (full, over, partial or none), the reserve ratio claimed, the underlying asset with its name, identifier (such as an ISIN, a CUSIP or a bar list) and custodian, and the wording, read for fully backed, 1:1, 100% reserves or audited; the supply with the tokens outstanding, the value each token claims and its date; each reserve, audit, attestation, proof-of-reserves or self-reported report with its id, date, author, the reserves it states and the tokens outstanding it states; each mint and burn record with its id, tokens, date and whether a matching deposit or payout is recorded; the date the backing is read at; and optionally the days a report may age (45 when left out). The signed report gives the claim with the ratio claimed, the underlying and the wording found, the reserves with every report, the latest report’s age, the tokens outstanding, the value each claims and the reserve ratio computed, and the ledger with the tokens minted and burned, the net beside the supply and the mints with no deposit, and counts them, and names unproven backing: an underlying asset not identified, reserves below the ratio claimed, a latest report past its allowed age, mint and burn records that do not net to the supply, mints with no matching deposit and full-backing or audit wording the records contradict; then a self-reported latest report and a report supply that differs from the supply record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An unstated claim, no reports, reserves, supply or unit value, no reading date or report date, no mint and burn records and an underlying named with no identifier leave the backing unverified. This reads one token’s backing against its own records: the NAV the Atlas dataset records is wever_atlas-nav-evidence and a claim against offered evidence is wever_claim-evidence-check. Verdict tokenized_backing_unproven, tokenized_backing_partial, tokenized_backing_unverified or tokenized_backing_proven. POST /api/tokenized-backing-check. Reads the purchase records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Tokenized Asset Purchase reads the buyer’s own records for one purchase of a tokenized asset and checks each step before money moves: the quote against its stated terms, the platform’s terms against the buyer, the custody arrangement, the redemption path, the transfer restrictions, the settlement, the claimed backing and the full cost. Beside it, wever_atlas-asset-passport and wever_atlas-redemption-check read what the published Tokenization Atlas dataset records about an asset by its id, while a purchase check reads the records the buyer supplies for one purchase; and wever_vendor-quote-check and wever_price-truth-check read quotes and charges for goods, services and paid calls, while the quote and cost checks read a token purchase against its own terms. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/tokenized-purchase-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/tokenized-asset-purchase/.

text.description: Read for wording such as fully backed, 1:1, 100% reserves or audited.

identifier.description: Such as an ISIN, a CUSIP or a bar list.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

backed.description: Whether a matching deposit or payout is recorded.

max_report_age_days.description: Days a report may age; 45 when left out.

read_at.description: The date the backing is read at, such as 2026-11-20.
